task: Epic 36 (Learning Methodology Examples, Best-Practice Ledger and the Review-Triage Learning Loop - Stories 36.1 to 36.6): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria for 36.1, 36.4 and 36.5 are contract-testable: pure functions, plus declared shape files that must load with ComplexityProfile.from_dict and contain exact action ids (36.5 AC_4 to AC_6). Stories 36.2 and 36.3 are run-and-check criteria.
Stories trace to FDD-036 contracts, BRU-036 rules and ADR-036 sections, and each rule sits in one story's criteria (LL-012).

Six stories split the catalog, the 9 runnable examples, the 10 sketches, the ledger, the triage loop and the tailoring and propagation work. Declaring the two policy shapes is now in both FDD-036 section 2.4 and Story 36.5; initializing the policies in a store stays a maintainer step outside the epic.
